cautions: Substring maps need context checks: in the MBC job, 드립 was NOT the song DRIP — all 4 hits were the polite verb ending 드립니다. Never substitute blind.
Variants must be distinctive strings. A variant that is a substring of ordinary words will false-positive the validator; when in doubt, leave it out and catch the case in the block pass instead.
notes: Reference pack. Canonical forms are what the output must use; variants are literal wrong strings the validator bans and counts in old drafts. Member names display in ALL CAPS. Song titles display in Title Case as listed.

source_substitutions.note: ASR mishearing of 아현 (아연 literally means 'zinc'). In the MBC Radio job 17 of 18 아연 hits were name contexts (아연실색/아연히: 0). High value, but verify context before applying.
